info.name: UC-003 Payroll Calculation
info.description:
Every /api/uc003 endpoint plus the failure paths (401 / 403 / 404 / 409 / 422).

PRECONDITION — run against a freshly reset database:
  npm run db:reset   (from the project root)
  cd backend && npm run dev

Run the requests IN ORDER (Collection Runner does this): later requests reuse ids captured by earlier ones (periodId, runId, lineId, adjustmentId, inputId, rateSetId) and the state machine only moves one way (validated -> calculated -> pending_approval).

Running the whole collection mutates the demo data — reset again before demoing.

Auth: two accounts are registered (manager + accounting) so the role guards can be proved. Registration tolerates 409 EMAIL_TAKEN so a re-run without a reset still works.
